63: -- Let addons alter colors before the gems are created. This is weird,
64: -- since there's no base class to call it for, since it's just a
65: -- table. To bind:
66: -- class.bindHook('GemColorAttributes', function(gem_color_attributes) ... end)
67: class.triggerHook(gem_color_attributes, {'GemColorAttributes',})

69: local function newGem(name, image, cost, rarity, color, min_level, max_level, tier, power, imbue, bomb)
70: 	-- Gems, randomly lootable
71: 	newEntity{ base = "BASE_GEM", define_as = "GEM_"..name:gsub(" ", "_"):upper(),
72: 		name = name:lower(), subtype = color,
73: 		color = colors[color:upper()], image=image,
74: 		level_range = {min_level, max_level},
75: 		rarity = rarity, cost = cost * 10,
76: 		material_level = tier,
77: 		imbue_powers = imbue,
78: 		wielder = imbue,
79: 		attack_type = gem_color_attributes[color].damage_type, -- deprecated, hopefully nothing's still using it.
80: 		color_attributes = gem_color_attributes[color],
81: 	}
82: 	-- Alchemist gems, not lootable, only created by talents
83: 	newEntity{ base = "BASE_GEM", define_as = "ALCHEMIST_GEM_"..name:gsub(" ", "_"):upper(),		name = "alchemist "..name:lower(), type='alchemist-gem', subtype = color,
84: 		slot = "QUIVER",
85: 		moddable_tile = resolvers.moddable_tile("gembag"),
86: 		use_no_wear = false,
87: 		color = colors[color:upper()], image=image,
88: 		cost = cost * 0.01,
89: 		material_level = tier,
90: 		alchemist_power = power,
91: 		alchemist_bomb = bomb,
92: 	}
93: end
